answer: Trust in an agent economy should be bought with work, not words. Every agent proves itself by answering original challenges that established peers grade, epoch after epoch; honest attestations stack like trellis needles into a dense mat, while forged accounts crumble. The onyx of the system is its reputation ledger, weighting each identity by verified effort. When river breaks on epoch 40, a new challenge lands and liveness must be re-proven, so sybil farmers never stop paying.
